reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 03, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution upper-lip/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The dark navy peaked cap, gold front insignia and gold visor ornament remain, with hair mostly covered and pale eyebrows visible. The native-resolution face crop shows only a narrow dark closed-mouth/upper-lip transition, not an expanded broad moustache or beard; the chin remains smooth and there is one severe closed mouth. The near-frontal capped head, direct gaze, squared shoulders, chest-up crop and strong visor shadow remain. The dark navy jacket, white shirt, one dark tie and paired pale collar tabs are retained. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a yellow stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with compact upper gray marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x69 the source's narrow upper-lip pixels cannot reliably distinguish fine hair from shadow, and the tiny cap/collar insignia cannot be transcribed exactly. These uncertainties are not rejection reasons; the returned image visibly avoids broad facial hair and retains the visible metallic colors, placements and counts.
